g.text: J1: WAVESHARE ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-2.8B J7 (2x12, 2.54 mm). 11 GPIO0, 13 GPIO4 (R24 lifted), 17/19 I2C SCL/SDA (GPIO7/15), 18 GPIO43, 20 GPIO44

g.desc: J1: WAVESHARE ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-2.8B J7 (2x12, 2.54 mm). 11 GPIO0, 13 GPIO4 (R24 lifted), 17/19 I2C SCL/SDA (GPIO7/15), 18 GPIO43, 20 GPIO44

g.text: FAN INTERFACE - FAN DOMAIN (GND_F). Fail-off, isolated (SR-08, SR-09, D-023, D-054; interfaces §2.1). >= 3 mm to node copper (pcb/SAFETY.md)

g.desc: FAN INTERFACE - FAN DOMAIN (GND_F). Fail-off, isolated (SR-08, SR-09, D-023, D-054; interfaces §2.1). >= 3 mm to node copper (pcb/SAFETY.md)

g.text: Hand-soldered. Stack-up mirrors the pin rows: check against the Waveshare STEP at layout.

g.desc: Hand-soldered. Stack-up mirrors the pin rows: check against the Waveshare STEP at layout.

g.text: J-FAN = J2 + J7: J2.1 GND (BLK), J2.2 +10V (RED), J7.1 SPD (YEL), J7.2 TACH (WHT)

g.desc: J-FAN = J2 + J7: J2.1 GND (BLK), J2.2 +10V (RED), J7.1 SPD (YEL), J7.2 TACH (WHT)

g.text: J-OCC: 24 VAC lighting signal (FR-07, interfaces §2.2) - OCC field domain

g.desc: J-OCC: 24 VAC lighting signal (FR-07, interfaces §2.2) - OCC field domain

g.text: SEN65 (D-012) on +3V3. Shares the Waveshare I2C bus; its pull-ups are on that board, so ours are DNP pads (D-054)

g.desc: SEN65 (D-012) on +3V3. Shares the Waveshare I2C bus; its pull-ups are on that board, so ours are DNP pads (D-054)

g.text: INDICATOR: 6 x SK6812SIDE-A on the carrier's room-side edge (D-055, FR-15). GPIO0 -> 2N7002 inverter (RMT invert_out). 10k gate pull-up keeps GPIO0 high at reset (normal boot) and DIN low. Firmware caps LED current at 300 mA

g.desc: INDICATOR: 6 x SK6812SIDE-A on the carrier's room-side edge (D-055, FR-15). GPIO0 -> 2N7002 inverter (RMT invert_out). 10k gate pull-up keeps GPIO0 high at reset (normal boot) and DIN low. Firmware caps LED current at 300 mA
